verdict.rationale: Lever documents a REST Data API, OAuth, webhooks, and an integrator sandbox. Its partner page mentions step-by-step guides and example apps. None of the evidence names an official client SDK in any language. A raw REST API and example apps are developer building blocks adjacent to SDKs, not official SDKs themselves, so they earn no credit for this applicable axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
